name: Mohammad Ashiqul Islam
shortDescription: I'm a software engineer with expertise in C#, .NET, JavaScript, NodeJS, and RESTful APIs
title: I am a .NET developer with experience in both back-end and front-end development. Strong engineering skills in C#, JavaScript, NodeJs, NestJS, NextJS, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and object oriented design.

description: I'm a software engineer with expertise in JavaScript, NodeJS, and RESTful APIs. I'm passionate about creating scalable backend systems and contributing to dynamic projects that push the boundaries of what's possible in web development.
When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or enjoying a good cup of coffee while brainstorming innovative solutions to complex problems.

responsibilities: Developing and maintaining scalable web applications using .NET, .NET Framework, and C#, ensuring performance, security, and maintainability.
Designing and implementing RESTful APIs to enable seamless integration between frontend, backend, and third-party services.
Optimizing application performance through SQL Server schema design, complex query writing, and database tuning.
Deployed a Dockerized WireGuard VPN on Raspberry Pi with Nginx reverse proxy to securely access IP-restricted development environments.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot production issues, minimize downtime, and improve system reliability.
Developed high-performance RESTful APIs using .NET, Entity Framework, and SQL Server, optimizing scalability and data handling, resulting in a 30% increase in data retrieval speed.
Designed and implemented modern, user-friendly frontend interfaces using NextJS, improving engagement and usability.
Integrated secure payment gateways including Nagad and bKash for seamless transaction processing.
Developed scalable backend APIs using NestJS, TypeORM, and MySQL, ensuring efficient and maintainable data management.
Implemented fast and accurate search functionality using ElasticSearch (NoSQL), significantly improving search performance.
Built responsive and intuitive frontend interfaces using NextJS and Vue.
Migrated legacy .NET applications and databases from virtual machines to Microsoft Azure, improving performance and reducing infrastructure costs.
Developed enterprise-grade software solutions for large-scale business systems.
Implemented system designs following coding standards and best practices.
Analyzed existing systems to identify and resolve bugs, improving stability and user experience.
Wrote optimized code and SQL queries and provided ongoing support for production systems.

projects.title: Online Exam System

points: Developed a robust backend API using NestJS and TypeScript for exam management and result processing.
Built a responsive frontend using NextJS for seamless exam participation and result viewing.
Integrated PostgreSQL for secure and scalable storage of users, exams, and results.
Implemented a real-time leaderboard system to increase user engagement.
Designed a flexible exam creation system supporting both MCQ and written question types.
